allow: PowerShell($userPath = [Environment]::GetEnvironmentVariable\('PATH', 'User'\); Write-Output "--- CURRENT USER PATH ---"; Write-Output $userPath; Write-Output "--- LENGTH ---"; Write-Output $userPath.Length; Write-Output "--- CONTAINS Git\\usr\\bin? ---"; if \($userPath -match [regex]::Escape\('C:\\Program Files\\Git\\usr\\bin'\)\) { Write-Output 'YES' } else { Write-Output 'NO' })
